notes.title: 1.0 - FULL RELEASE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44330273/44b0a2a0bf59ff14fbc3e1e516c2bdded8e0d041.png[/img]

1.0
[list]
[*] fixed some typos
[*] added a new secret place to visit 
[*] things like the [spoiler]wizard tent [/spoiler] will no longer spawn on the edge of the underground
[*] added ability to check equipped rings (view the manual to see how)
[*] fixed crashes when running the game through steam
[*] added sound for the wall spell
[*] updated the manual
[/list]

There are now also collectible cards! 

There is not much to be said here. I hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: 0.3.5 - bug fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] friendly bullets no longer show as enemy bullets when back vision effect is active
[*] fixed some enemy bullets and enemies not showing when back vision effect is active
[*] fixed staying in crouch without holding the button after interacting with something while crouching
[*] fixed some typos
[*] slight adjustments to SteamAPI to hopefully prevent some crashes on startup
[*] fixed keyboard movement being broken when a PS controller is plugged in (but pls let me know if someone is still experiencing this, this one is somewhat inconsistent and therefore difficult to test)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.3 - BIG UPDATE: NEW BOSS, SPELL, NPC AND MORE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44330273/b2bf476216132d31220aea91ef83c44830cb246f.png[/img]
[h2]Additions:[/h2]
[list]
[*] added a new chaos related enemy and an additional effect to the Chaos Ring and gave it a little more options for randomization
[*] summoning circles may now appear in the dungeons and have a secret spell related interaction
[*] added a new npc to talk to
[*] added bone ring unlockable via [spoiler] discussing death with the wizard [/spoiler]
[*] added a new spell
[*] added new boss
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments:[/h2]
[list]
[*] cleaned up collection unlocks so there are no items or enemies that are impossible to unlock
[*] the Chaos Ring can no longer summon Kenneth or the Face to keep their reveal fun and related to their own rings
[*]  increased the Huntsman's and Flesh Golem's health a bit
[*] fully integrated steam API in preparation for achievements release
[*] reduced the limit of dream spheres that can be offered to increase spell cost so spells are never completely free
[*] adjustments to how dream sphere unlocks are calculated and saved - please let me know if you run into any issues
[/list]

notes.title: 0.2.3 - small update: new textures for shop and tweaks
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] added new wall and floor textures for the shop
[*] moved underground occlusion further so there's no flickering when jumping there
[*] typo fixes, text edits here and there
[*] optimisation tweaks
[*] the hand icon now disappears when you can no longer interact with certain items
[/list]

notes.title: 0.2.2 - SWORDS IN STONE + PROGRESSION & SHOP CHANGES
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44330273/3218416c3c5d795153a6936ff00ab119b1068da2.png[/img][list]
[*] swords stuck in stone can now be found in dungeons
[*] changed progression through the two new levels so it is a bit more secret, and added surrounding lore
[*] the adviser in the bottom of the screen now has more to say about portals when looking at them
[*] shop now becomes more expensive as you progress through the dungeon
[/list]

notes.title: 0.2 MAJOR UPDATE: NEW SECRET ENDING, LEVELS, ITEMS, ENEMIES, BOSSES AND MORE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44330273/bd6b53d139fd777a68a5d15805ba826a787afda3.jpg[/img]
[h2]NEW CONTENT:[/h2]
[list]
[*] new secret ending
[*] 2 new secret levels 
[*] 2 bosses
[*] 6 enemy types
[*] 3 rings
[*] 2 weapons
[*] 4 new soundtracks
[*] new NPC
[*] added more text tablets
[*] added coin god altar
[*] added the concept of gold
[/list]

[h2]ADJUSTEMENTS/FIXES:[/h2]
[list]
[*] increased self damage on dussack shard
[*] increased coin damage of coin man
[*] increased distance between dropped items
[*] reduced healing multiplier and vampiric effect on rings
[*] changed the text of vampiric effect so it makes more sense
[*] increased speed of hell sword
[*] floor hatch no longer spawns in Dark Crystal
[*] blood golem notes should no longer drop under the floor
[*] slightly increased bladed ring damage
[*] Kenneth now turns his head correctly
[*] increased the chance of the warlock spawning
[*] added Gibert's missing sound effects
[*] slightly changed the homunculus sound to be less annoying(?)
[/list]

This is the biggest update so far! Some of this content is hidden and might be difficult to access, but I wish you luck, you can find it! If you discover any bugs, you can report them on Discord. It's also a good place to ask questions about hidden areas and mechanics. 
Discord invite: [url=https://discord.gg/GJD3rK7q82]https://discord.gg/GJD3rK7q82[/url]

In the next updates I am planning to get back to work on performance and balance. Even though this update touches the issue a bit, I am still planning on adding even more uses for gold, and thinking about making the shop more interesting. 
Hope you enjoy this update, and thanks for playing and supporting the game at this stage!

notes.title: 0.1.10 - STARTING WEAPON CHANGES + NEW ENEMY + FIXES!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44330273/5fdd5d8bf7f549e5e4a30e210a4cb1889dbac99b.jpg[/img][h2]New stuff:[/h2]
[list]
[*] added new enemy with a new mechanic
[*] ui flashes accordingly when earning/losing gold
[*] reforged dussack can now break
[*] added sound for flytrap enemy
[/list]
[h2] Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] increased chances of the pugilism altar spawning on various levels
[*] made secret doors more subtle and fixed slime level secret doors glowing
[*] re-added wizard lord's missing sounds
[*] fixed potential instability/crash when encountering potions smelling of beer

[/list]

There might be a couple of enemies and items in Collections that are not unlockable for now. Those are work in progress for upcoming updates. 

If you are interested in joining Dungeons of Blood and Dream discord, here is the invite: [url=https://discord.gg/GJD3rK7q82]https://discord.gg/GJD3rK7q82[/url]

Thanks a lot for playing the game and supporting it at this stage! I am looking forward to posting more updates soon.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.3 - Performance fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] lots of occlusion culling tweaks to improve performance,
[*] adjusted collision in the hub so you can't see through walls,
[*] all kinds of slime and spikes damage now ticks over time,
[*] fixed enemies sometimes not getting damaged when kicked into spikes,
[*] the obelisk and [spoiler]the lich[/spoiler]  should no longer aggro from accross the map,
[*] an additional enemy can sometimes spawn in rooms with obelisks,
[*] obelisks now indicate which enemies were summoned by them,
[*] current keys now show in the map overlay, 
[*] added a missing item ([spoiler] blood band[/spoiler] ) to the game which is now unlockable via [spoiler] the knight's dialogue[/spoiler] , 
[*] fixed typos of some item descriptions in collections,
[*] added a few more pages to the notebook,
[*] demons' projectiles no longer disappear when they hit pots and they can go through walls,
[*] fixed [spoiler] the hawk[/spoiler]  and other eyeball abilities getting stuck after spamming [spoiler]the hawk[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Mini patch 0.1.2
notes.notes:

[*] tweaked homing of slime wizards' slime projectiles,
[*] all homing projectiles are a bit more optimised now,
[*] slightly reduced damage increase from some rings,
[*] reverted change to dream sphere and brain drop rates,
[*] tweaked loot tables a bit to make one specific item less rare,

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 - improved performance and accessibility
notes.notes:
[h2]List of changes:[/h2]
[h3]Performance:[/h3]
[list]
[*] improved performance in rooms with lots of enemies,
[*] reduced the amount of projectiles on the first boss making him slightly easier and improving the performance,
[*] fixed spider ring performance and its bullets algorithm,
[/list]

[h3]Accessibility:[/h3]
[list]
[*] alt+enter now switches between windowed mode and full screen correctly,
[*] added button for resetting settings including control binds,
[*] added FOV slider,
[*] added slider for adjusting or disabling movement tilt,
[/list]

[h3]Tweaks and bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] edited text on one of the tablets to display correctly,
[*] fixed eyeball ability lasting too long when using some rings,
[*] removed fog from a secret area so you can actually see stuff,
[*] pet bullet now destroys pots,
[*] increased drop chance of dream spheres and brains,
[*] increased demon's attack damage as it was too low for some reason,
[*] letter combinations in the hub are now saved between hub visits,
[*] slightly reduced damage boost on potions,
[/list]

[h3]Bonus stuff:[/h3]
[list]
[*] added a couple more pages to the notebook,
[*] changed the order of pages in the manual so it's more logical,
[/list]
